settings.eyebrow: Sourced within 50 miles, served the same week
settings.headline:
From our farm to
your table.
settings.copy: Hearth & Harvest is a farm-to-table restaurant where the menu changes with the season. We grow what we can on our own land and buy the rest from the farmers next door.

settings.title: We grow, raise, and
settings.intro: Forty acres of vegetables, orchards, and pasture — worked by the same hands that cook your dinner.

features.title: Vegetable gardens
features.text: Heirloom tomatoes, greens, roots, and herbs planted in rotation for peak flavor, not shelf life.

features.title: Orchard & berries
features.text: Stone fruit, apples, and berries that go from branch to plate in under 48 hours.

features.title: Pasture-raised animals
features.text: Heritage-breed chickens, pigs, and lamb raised on open pasture with a humane, stress-free life.

features.title: Local partners
features.text: What we don't grow, we buy from neighbors: cheese, grain, seafood, and wine from within 50 miles.

features.title: Compost & soil
features.text: Every scrap returns to the fields. Our zero-waste kitchen feeds the soil that feeds us.

features.title: Seasonal menu
features.text: The chef writes the menu from what's ripe this week — so you always taste the season at its peak.

settings.title: We didn't start a restaurant.
settings.image_caption: Morning harvest — picked for tonight's menu

paragraphs.text: Hearth & Harvest began as a family farm selling at a roadside stand. The natural next step wasn't a bigger stand — it was a kitchen that could show off what we grow the way it deserves.
Today we seat forty guests a night, and every plate tells the story of the season: where it grew, who raised it, and how it got from the ground to your table in a matter of days.

settings.quote: If you can taste the sun, we've done our job.
